summary.name: SQLight
summary.one_liner: SQLight is a macOS SQLite database manager for browsing, editing, and querying local SQLite files, offered free by Aurvan Technologies.
use_cases: browse and edit data in a local SQLite file
run SQL queries against a SQLite database
export SQLite table data to a file
inspect BLOB or image data stored in SQLite
work on several SQLite databases in tabs
rename tables and view table structure
summary.what_it_does:
SQLight lets you browse, edit, and delete data in local SQLite files through a graphical interface. A left panel lists tables, views, and indexes, while the right panel provides controls to manage them. It includes a query box with SQL syntax coloring for running queries and displaying results. You can export data as a file, save cell contents (including BLOB) to disk, and use Quick Look on cells to preview images, text, or HTML. Multiple databases can be opened in tabs, and keyboard shortcuts switch between tabs and sections.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Opens multiple databases in browser-style tabs
Save any cell including BLOB to a file, and Quick Look preview of cell data
Keyboard shortcuts for tabs and segments (Table Structure, Table Data, SQL Query)
Planned 4.0.0.0 release adds SQL query history and custom syntax highlighting colors
caveats: Requires a Mac with an Intel Core processor and OS X 10.7 (Lion) or later
Future features such as query history are planned for version 4.0.0.0 and not yet available
